name: Playable Collections
description:
Open any Civitai collection and it plays straight through, images and videos alike.

Pick how it plays. Slideshow shows one item at a time and auto-advances, Ticker drifts sideways, Wall scrolls upward as a column feed. Set the seconds per image, the video loop count and the drift speed, shuffle the order, or narrow it to images or videos only. Play, pause, skip, scrub and go fullscreen from the transport bar, the arrow keys or a swipe. Ambient mode hides every control for passive, full-screen playback.

Browse public collections by most-followed or newest, search as you type, and keep scrolling for more. Sign in to reach your own — private ones included, once you grant access. Each collection you play counts as one vote per viewer, and a Popular rail builds out of those votes as more people use the app.

Follow a collection to keep it — Civitai asks you to confirm each follow itself, so the app never writes to your collections on its own. The only Buzz the app spends is a tip you send — to the creator of the media on screen, to the collection's curator, or split between the two — up to 5,000 Buzz per tip in total, with the amount and the split picked and confirmed by you first.

scopeJustifications.collections:read:private: Lets a signed-in viewer browse and play their own private collections (behind an explicit in-app consent prompt), in addition to public ones.
scopeJustifications.social:tip:self: Sends the viewer's Buzz tip to the creator of the media on screen, or to the collection's curator, or split between the two — within the per-tip and daily caps.
scopeJustifications.buzz:read:self: Reads the viewer's Buzz balance so a tip amount can be validated before it is sent.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:shared:write: Records the shared popular-collections rail entries (collection references and tallies) that are visible to all viewers.
